C api019.distinguish-when-beneficial OL API-019 DEFAULT ;; Health checks answer alive/ready; distinguish liveness from readiness when the deployment infrastructure benefits. ;; = ;; When infrastructure benefits. ;;
C x.hc-readiness-tags EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Register readiness checks with tags (and map readiness endpoints by tag). ;; = ;; none ;; Tagging/endpoint technique outside the oracle (EXC-010).
C api019.required-deps-only OL API-019 MUST ;; Include only dependencies required for meaningful readiness; an optional external service does not necessarily make the app unready. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.db-check-light OL API-018 MUST ;; Database health is a lightweight connectivity/availability check without expensive business queries, large scans or data modification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-framework-integration EX API-018 DEFAULT ;; Use provider/framework health-check integration where suitable. ;; = ;; Where suitable. ;; Implementation preference not in the oracle.
C api019.no-cascades OL API-019 AVOID ;; Check external dependencies only when they matter to readiness; avoid readiness cascades and remote dependency chains without operational justification; prefer a lightweight check of the needed capability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-status-mapping EX API-019 MUST_NOT ;; Health endpoints return success when healthy and non-success when unhealthy per the probe policy; do not reuse business API status semantics mechanically for orchestrator probes. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe status-mapping rule outside the oracle (EXC-010).
C api020.small-protected OL API-020 MUST ;; Keep probe responses small; protect detailed diagnostics endpoints with network or authorization controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-exposure EX API-020,SEC-006 DEFAULT ;; Choose health endpoint exposure from the deployment topology (internal network, management port, host restrictions, or authorization where probes support it). ;; = ;; none ;; Exposure-mechanics guidance outside the oracle (EXC-010).
C api019.startup-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; When initialization is asynchronous or slow keep readiness unhealthy until required startup work completes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.cheap-probes OL API-018 AVOID ;; Avoid expensive queries, long external timeouts, large allocations and full business workflows in frequently run health checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-no-error-logs EX RUN-013,API-018 AVOID ;; Avoid Error-level logs for every normal failed probe. ;; = ;; none ;; Logging-level rule for probes not in the oracle.
C x.hc-testing EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test meaningful health configuration when deployment relies on it (live endpoint, readiness vs required dependency, no sensitive leakage, optional-dependency semantics); no elaborate tests of uncustomized framework behaviour. ;; = ;; When deployment relies on it. ;; Health-check test obligations beyond the oracle.
C x.hc-no-grading EX API-018 AVOID ;; Avoid using health checks as a code-quality grading system. ;; = ;; none ;; Anti-pattern not stated in API-018..API-020.

138 NN ;; Heading.
140-150 DU ;; Decision-guide table restating resilience defaults (bounded time, safe retry, Retry-After, circuit breaker, fallback, hedging, EF execution strategy, rate limiter).

C run016.match-semantics OL RUN-016,RUN-018 MUST ;; Match resilience policies to the failure and operation semantics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-resilience-by-default OL GOV-013,DEP-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add resilience mechanisms merely because they are available. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-observe EX - DEFAULT ;; Observe retries, timeouts and circuit behaviour when they materially affect operations; give important production circuit breakers operational visibility. ;; = ;; When material. ;; Observability obligation for resilience not in the oracle.
C dep020.mex-apis OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Application code uses the Microsoft.Extensions resilience APIs (built on Polly v8) rather than Polly directly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.standard-handler-review OL RUN-016 MUST ;; The standard resilience handler is optional; review its retry behaviour carefully for state-changing requests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.attempt-vs-total OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Distinguish attempt timeout from total operation timeout, especially with retries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.no-unsafe-retry OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry non-idempotent operations without duplicate prevention, retry every exception/status, or hedge writes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-not-retried EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry validation errors, authentication/authorization failures, permanent 404 outcomes or deterministic business rejections. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit non-retryable categories beyond RUN-016's safety criterion.
C run017.follow-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; When a remote endpoint returns Retry-After let the policy follow it instead of an independent aggressive schedule. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.duplicate-unsafe OL RUN-016 MUST ;; If repeating a write could duplicate side effects automatic retry is unsafe; use an API-supported idempotency mechanism when appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-no-invented-idempotency-key EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent a client-side Idempotency-Key unless the remote service supports that contract. ;; = ;; none ;; Specific prohibition not stated in RUN-016.
C x.res-circuit-breaker EX RUN-015 DEFAULT ;; Use a circuit breaker only when repeated calls to a failing dependency would add load/latency (not without a repeated-failure pattern). ;; = ;; none ;; Circuit-breaker technique is outside the oracle (EXC-007).
C run016.hedging-safe-only OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Use hedging only for operations safe to execute multiple times (idempotent reads on interchangeable endpoints), never for state-changing operations by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-db-resilience EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not wrap normal EF Core operations in a generic application-level retry pipeline by default; prefer EF Core execution strategies/provider configuration and follow provider transaction/retry guidance; HTTP retry policies are not automatically appropriate for databases. ;; = ;; none ;; Database-retry technique outside the oracle (EXC-007).
C x.res-messaging EX RUN-016 DEFAULT ;; Retrying publication can duplicate delivery; use idempotent consumers, broker deduplication or outbox when required; retry does not give exactly-once delivery. ;; = ;; When the business requirement needs it. ;; Message-delivery technique outside the oracle (EXC-007).
C x.res-inbound-429 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Inbound ASP.NET Core rate limiting is distinct from outbound resilience; rejected requests normally return 429 with Retry-After when a useful delay is known. ;; = ;; none ;; HTTP rate-limiting semantics not in the oracle.
C run019.propagate-cancellation OL RUN-019,RUN-003 MUST ;; Propagate cancellation through resilience pipelines so a cancelled caller ends the pipeline instead of triggering further attempts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-otel-requirement OL GOV-013,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require OpenTelemetry solely because resilience handlers are present; use the adopted telemetry stack. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.no-overlap OL RUN-015,RUN-017 AVOID ;; Avoid stacked handlers with overlapping strategies and unbounded retry/timeout combinations. ;; = ;; none ;;
